title: Outside Security HQ
content: First I was in Europe with my family, then I was back in my childhood home where someone was cooking in the kitchen. We ate, canoodled, then she took me to part of the mall where security worked. She took me up a ladder to a rooftop, we momentarily had to move out of the way of a crew passing by, then across the roof to a descending ladder. We made it to the ground, and I felt free. The cement was a lattice pattern with grass growing out of the empty space, the signage was surrounded by flowers and other foliage, and the air clean feeling. It felt like I was on campus of a prestigious institution. After reading and posting on this sub, I truly believe my subconscious is trying to break the mall world immersion. I keep becoming lucid and just want to be outside. At no point did I feel threatened or scared, just sayin!
